6737907910.description:
Local AI. Online models. Your computer, within reach.

OneLLM brings everyday AI and your computer’s agents into one workspace on iPhone and iPad.

CHOOSE HOW YOU CHAT
Download a compatible model for on-device, offline chat, or use your own credentials with supported online providers. Connect to Ollama or OpenClaw on a reachable server. Different tasks call for different models.

BIGGER LOCAL MODELS
An optional 35-billion-parameter MoE package uses expert streaming with about 3B active parameters. Smaller text and vision models are also available. Model capability, speed and memory needs vary by device.

YOUR ONELLM OFFICE, ON YOUR PHONE
Pair with a compatible OneLLM Office computer using its connection code. Continue a conversation, choose an available local or online model, follow task progress and respond to approvals. Open task files from a separate Files view. The desktop preview must remain running and reachable; desktop release availability may vary.

OPENCODE MOBILE CONNECTOR
Connect to OpenCode on your computer from iOS. Continue sessions, choose models and agents, browse files, review changes and respond to permissions. Scan the matching connection code or enter the service address.

DEEPSEEK HARNESS CONNECTION
Keep DS Harness conversations and workspaces close. Send messages and supported attachments, follow agent activity and continue from your phone. Use the DS Harness connection code in its matching module.

PHOTOS, FILES AND VOICE
See image previews in chat, check attachments before sending and remove them with a tap. English voice input uses bundled local transcription. Notes and on-device text recognition are also included.

Local models require a separate download, storage and compatible hardware. The optional 35B package needs about 16.6 GB of storage; 12 GB RAM is recommended. Remote connections require a running computer and a reachable trusted LAN, Tailscale network or supported secure service address. Computer services use the model accounts configured there. Direct online chat requires your own provider credentials; provider subscriptions and API charges are not included. Review AI output before using it.

6756238255.description:
Hello, I'm so glad you found totododo!
It's a tailor-made, minimalist Todo-list app designed and developed specifically for people with ADHD (and of course, it’s completely usable for everyone else too).
Yes, I am an independent developer; and at the same time, I am also a person with ADHD.
That’s why I’m a bit spontaneous, a bit socially anxious, and struggle with procrastination, dyslexia, attention deficit, decision paralysis, carelessness, and a touch of forgetfulness.
Whether at school or in the workplace, I have always felt the prejudice against ADHD. So I had to pretend to be an efficiency fanatic, a detail fanatic, and a punctuality fanatic.
But mentally, to pull this off, I have to put in more effort than you can possibly imagine—far more than the average person!
That’s why I created this "targeted" minimalist todo list app for the ADHD community, and for myself: it’s called totododo.
After launching it on the App Store, I realized I was not alone. Less than a month after its official release, totododo has gained users in dozens of countries and regions around the world.
Today, I was pleasantly surprised to find a thank-you email from a user in South Korea in my inbox.
Every day, users reach out to me with their ideas and needs. Seeing this, I think I have earned the recognition of ADHD "comrades" worldwide.
I’m truly happy to be able to help everyone. As the saying goes, "God helps those who help themselves."
If you also have ADHD, don’t miss out on this app.
If you’re not sure whether you have ADHD, totododo comes with a built-in ADHD test that you can use for self-assessment.
I will continue to iterate and improve this app for all of you. May the world understand ADHD, and be kind to those who live with it.


[ Core Features ]
> Smart Task Lists: Create multiple colorful task lists for different projects, goals, or life areas. With a clean and intuitive interface, switching between lists is as easy as scrolling! Each list has its own distinct identifier, making organization a breeze.
> Intuitive Task Creation & Management: Pull down to refresh and create new tasks instantly, swipe right to mark complete, swipe left to delete, and shake to undo accidental deletions! Each task gets a beautiful random color to add visual charm to your lists.
> Pomodoro Focus Timer: Boost productivity with totododo's built-in Pomodoro timer. Customize focus sessions, short breaks, and long breaks. Link timer sessions to specific tasks to track progress and build better work habits.
> Lucky Wheel for Decision Fatigue: Can't decide which task to tackle next? Spin the interactive Lucky Wheel! It randomly selects from your pending tasks, adding fun to your workflow while helping you overcome decision paralysis.
> Smart Reminders: Never miss a deadline again! Set start and end date reminders for your most important tasks. totododo will notify you at the right time, keeping you on track without stress.
> Export Your Achievements: Proud of your organized lists? Export them as stunning images to share with friends, colleagues, or social media. Show off your productivity journey!
> Recycle Bin Safety Net: Accidentally deleted a list? Don't panic! totododo's Recycle Bin safely stores your deleted lists for easy recovery, giving you peace of mind.
> Widgets & Live Activities: Stay connected to your tasks even when you're not in the app. View your tasks directly from the home screen with totododo's widgets. The streamlined Live Activities feature lets you check your current Pomodoro session at a glance.
> Beautiful Design, Smooth Experience
Totododo features a modern, minimalist design with fluid animations and haptic feedback, making every interaction a joy. The app seamlessly adapts to your iOS devices, providing a consistent experience across all screen sizes.
> Privacy-First
>Your tasks are your business. totododo uses Apple's secure SwiftData storage to ensure your data remains private and encrypted on your device.

Capture life's details. Make room for your day.

Appointments, meeting messages, shopping lists—the things you want to remember often live in screenshots and copied text. NoteAhead helps turn them into events, reminders, and checklists. Review the details, save your items, and receive local notifications when it's time.
- CAPTURE FROM SCREENSHOTS AND TEXT
  Import a screenshot or image to recognize its text, or paste a message to organize an upcoming plan. You can also send supported text and images to NoteAhead through the system share menu, reducing manual entry.
- ORGANIZE SEVERAL ITEMS AT ONCE
  One message can contain more than one plan. NoteAhead can identify multiple items from a single import, so you can review each one, make changes, and save the items you choose together.
- REVIEW BEFORE YOU SAVE
  Check and edit titles, dates, times, locations, notes, and checklist contents. Refer to the original text as you review. Correct unclear or incomplete details before saving, so you stay in control of your plans.
- SET ALERTS YOUR WAY
  Choose an alert at the scheduled time or in advance. Set daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly repeats, adjust intervals and end conditions, and choose a time zone for each item.
- SEE TODAY AND WHAT'S NEXT
  View today's agenda and upcoming items from the home screen. Filter your task list by all, incomplete, or completed items. Mark a task complete, undo completion, or delete it. Keep unfinished imports as drafts to continue later, and revisit your import history.
- KEEP PERSONAL DETAILS ON YOUR DEVICE
  Text recognition and parsing happen on your device and work offline. No account is required. NoteAhead has no ads, tracking, or content uploads. Your items stay inside NoteAhead, with alerts delivered through local notifications.
- A CALMER PLACE FOR EVERYDAY PLANS
  Cream paper tones and sage accents give NoteAhead the feel of a personal journal. Dark mode, scalable text, and 11 interface languages help it fit the way you use your device.
Please review recognition results before saving. Notifications require permission and depend on iOS settings, including Focus. NoteAhead queues up to 60 upcoming alerts; open the app regularly to refresh recurring reminders and remaining alerts. Cloud sync and data backup are not provided. Deleting the app removes its locally stored data.

1541419476.releaseNotes:
PQ Calc 2.0 is a complete rebuild: the same calculator, now on iPhone, iPad, Mac and iPhone Duo.

A new design. Every format on one screen, with controls that look and work like the rest of your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Type in any row and every other row updates as you type. Dark Mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver throughout.

iPhone Duo, iPad and Mac. One app for all of them. Open iPhone Duo in landscape and the chart sits beside the values; stand it half open and the chart takes the upper half. On Mac: a menu bar, keyboard shortcuts, Undo and as many windows as you need.

Luminance row. Start from a light level: enter nits or foot-lamberts and read the code at every bit depth.

Live PQ EOTF chart. The curve follows the selected row, on a log or linear luminance scale. Drag across it to set a value.

Half Float. A third signal row beside Percent and Float: the signal as FP16, with the luminance that rounding gives.

Nits or foot-lamberts. One switch, applied everywhere.

Choose your rows. Show only the bit depths and signal formats you use, in the order you want.

Neighboring codes. The codes nearest the current one, each with its luminance. Choose one to make it the current value.

Reference tab. Fourteen common levels from 0.005 to 10,000 nits, each with its code value, or its signal value when Percent, Float or Half Float is selected. And a short guide to Full, SDI-Full and Narrow range. (Narrow is the range 1.x labeled SMPTE.)

Share and copy. Share the visible rows as text, or copy any value with its units. On Mac, Copy As gives a tab-separated or CSV table for a spreadsheet.

Handoff. Start a calculation on one device and continue it on another.

Underneath it all, a rebuilt calculation engine with higher precision across all bit depths, following ITU-R BT.2100 and SMPTE RP 2077. Code values at 8, 10, 12 and 16 bits in Full, SDI-Full and Narrow range, and luminance shown to the digits that tell neighboring codes apart.

PQ Calc 2.0 requires iOS 27, iPadOS 27 or macOS 27 or later.
1541419476.description:
PQ Calc converts between light levels and video code values on the PQ curve (SMPTE ST 2084), the HDR transfer function. Every format is on one screen: type in any row and every other row updates as you type.

PQ is absolute, so every code value means one exact luminance. PQ Calc answers the questions that come up all day in HDR work. What luminance is 10-bit code 520? Which 12-bit code is 203 nits in Narrow range? How dark is code 1, really? It's made for color scientists, colorists, display engineers and calibrators, and for anyone who needs to know exactly what a signal means.

ONE SCREEN, EVERY FORMAT
• Luminance in nits or foot-lamberts
• Code values at 8, 10, 12 and 16 bits, in Full, SDI-Full or Narrow range
• Percent, Float and Half Float (FP16): the normalized signal E′, the same in every range
• Type into any row, including Luminance, and the rest follow
• Each code row shows the exact luminance of that code, and Half Float shows the luminance of the rounded FP16 value

THE PQ CURVE, LIVE
• A PQ EOTF chart that follows the selected row, with the current value marked on the curve
• Log or linear luminance scale; linear shows the curve exactly as ST 2084 defines it
• Drag across the plot to set a value; code rows snap to whole codes
• Neighboring codes: the codes nearest the current one, each with its luminance

REFERENCE
• Fourteen common levels from 0.005 to 10,000 nits, including 48 nits (cinema), 100 nits (SDR reference) and 203 nits (BT.2408 HDR reference white), each with its code value in the current range, or its signal value when Percent, Float or Half Float is selected
• A short guide to Full, SDI-Full and Narrow range, the 16-bit extension and the signal E′
• Tap a level to load it into the calculator

MADE FOR IPHONE, IPAD, MAC AND IPHONE DUO
• One app for all of them
• iPhone Duo: the chart beside the values when open in landscape, and a chart-first layout when the device stands half open
• iPad and Mac: two panes when there's room, keyboard shortcuts, and the value under the pointer when you hover over the chart
• Mac: a full menu bar, multiple windows, Undo, Copy As (tab-separated or CSV) and a standard Settings window
• Handoff: continue a calculation on another of your devices

PRECISE BY DESIGN
• Exact SMPTE ST 2084 constants; quantization follows ITU-R BT.2100 Table 9, rounding half away from zero
• SDI-Full clips to the SDI-legal codes rather than rescaling, as SMPTE RP 2077 specifies
• Luminance shown to the digits that tell neighboring codes apart, so 10-bit code 1 reads 0.0000404 nits, never 0
• Decimal places: Auto, 2, 4 or 6

MAKE IT YOURS
• Show only the rows you use, in the order you want
• Share the visible rows as text, or copy any value with its units
• Dark Mode, Dynamic Type up to the accessibility sizes, and VoiceOver with an audio graph for the chart

PRIVATE
PQ Calc has no account, no analytics and no tracking. Nothing you enter leaves your device unless you share it or hand it off to another of your own devices.

Requires iOS 27, iPadOS 27 or macOS 27 or later. The Mac version runs on Apple silicon.
